one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26845）：Agima（Agentic Imagination）训练单个 omni 模型 'propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment'，先 SFT 统一 policy 与 world model，再用 agentic RL 教它用这些想象中的未来做规划。最强的一条数字：'Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%'——在真环境反馈稀疏且动作不可逆时，'先想象再执行' 的收益是 20 倍量级。行为层面的证据比分数更有价值：'it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points'，即 'learn when and where to look ahead'。代码与项目页今日已实测可达：项目页 https://agima.net/ （HTTP 200），仓库 https://github.com/Agentic-Imagination/Agima 。属 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 的即时资产，但迁移风险必须写清：证据全部来自 Maze2D / Sokoban / Pacman / PushT 四个玩具环境，'generalizes to harder settings unseen during training' 尚未在真实工具链上验证。今日动作：先读仓库确认 omni 模型的训练成本量级。
